At Rose Rocket, work feels different. We’re building a company where people show up because they want to, not because they have to. That means you’ll find a group of people who take their work seriously, but not themselves. We work hard, we laugh a lot, and we care about one another as much as we care about the product.

Nothing here is small or simple. You’ll often be asked to figure things out without a perfect playbook, and that’s part of the fun. The problems are big, but so is the impact. Every improvement we make touches real people in trucking and logistics, an industry that keeps the world moving.

Rose Rocket Pricing — TMS Plans for Brokers & Carriers
Your Panel, Arranged Your Way
Build formula fields like revenue per mile using your own logic, and let them recalculate the moment the underlying data changes. The metrics your team manages by, live on every single record.
Track order volume, lane performance, and carrier scorecards from dashboards that build themselves off your live data. Spot the trend early, while there is still time to do something about it.

Nothing here is small or simple. You’ll often be asked to figure things out without a perfect playbook, and that’s part of the fun. The problems are big, but so is the impact. Every improvement we make touches real people in trucking and logistics, an industry that keeps the world moving.
Getting Started for Carriers
Carrier Specific Reports
This report provides a comprehensive analysis of order counts, revenue, and costs across various dimensions, including order status and customer.
Your revenue and cost breakdown for each customer

This report offers a detailed breakdown of orders by customer, including timeframe comparisons. It focuses on delivered orders and provides insights into order counts, revenue, costs, margin, weight, skids, and mileage.
Changes in revenue and costs compared to the previous month or year
This report lets you analyze month-over-month trends of delivered order metrics, including order counts, revenue, costs, margins, and weight.
Track week-over-week variations in order metrics like order counts, revenue, costs, margins, and weight for informed decision-making.
This report offers insights into accessorials, including the top 10 by revenue, a comparison of quoted vs. invoiced orders with accessorials, and a breakdown by customer.
Which accessorials generate the highest revenue for our business
This report provides a breakdown of order revenue by people on commission, allowing you to see top performers, pending amounts, billed amounts, total amounts, and a detailed breakdown of commissions.
The top-performing salespeople or CSRs based on revenue
Assess bills owed to drivers or partner carriers, offering detailed bill information for both driver and carrier manifests.
What are the bill details for carrier manifests completed within the last month?
The on-time performance for specific legs, such as deliveries, origin arrivals, and pickups
The order count and revenue trended over time for each mode, especially FTL and LTL
The states that have the highest order counts, revenue, and weight for your shipments
This report offers a detailed breakdown of open bills by partner carrier, providing insights into the accounts payables owed to your partner carriers.
What is owed to specific partner carriers in outstanding bills
Breakdown of overdue bills for a particular partner carrier

Revenue per mile and cost per mile breakdowns by each driver
Explore leg and manifest data, including mileage counts, revenues, costs, and margins, all grouped by Dispatcher, facilitating in-depth analysis of your operations.
This report reveals insights into the average and total wait times experienced by drivers between their arrival and pickup or delivery, categorized by customer.

This report provides insights into legs and manifests profitability, focusing on equipment-specific data, including total legs, revenue, cost, margin, manifest miles, and various other profitability metrics.
